name: HHRG
recent: HHRG 近期完成了一项土地收购，并有多项凭单 B 行使转换为新股。公司也出现董事会变动，Tan Sri Syed Azman 出任执行主席并增持股份。此外，公司有一项重大诉讼正在进行中。
notable: 公司全资子公司 OPen Road (East Coast) Sdn. Bhd. 已完成收购位于 Terengganu 的一块土地。
Tan Sri Syed Azman 被任命为执行主席，随后增持了公司股份。
公司有多项凭单 B 行使，涉及发行新股。
risks: 公司存在重大诉讼事项。
公司首席财务官在闭市期间进行了凭单 B 的交易。
一名主要股东 (Ng Kok Ming) 和 Aperta Holdings Sdn Bhd 已不再是大股东。
earnings: 最近一期财报 (2026年6月30日) 显示，营收为 MYR 23.3 million，同比下降 23.4%；净利润为 MYR 643,000，同比下降 62.7%，净利率为 2.8%。

recent_en: HHRG recently completed a land acquisition and saw multiple exercises of Warrants B into new shares. There were also boardroom changes, with Tan Sri Syed Azman appointed as Executive Chairman and increasing his stake. Additionally, the company has an ongoing material litigation.
notable_en: The Company's wholly-owned subsidiary, OPen Road (East Coast) Sdn. Bhd., has completed the acquisition of a piece of land in Terengganu.
Tan Sri Syed Azman was appointed as Executive Chairman and subsequently increased his shareholding in the Company.
There were multiple exercises of Warrants B involving the issuance of new shares.
risks_en: The Company has a material litigation matter.
The Chief Financial Officer dealt in Warrants B during the closed period.
A substantial shareholder (Ng Kok Ming) and Aperta Holdings Sdn Bhd have ceased to be substantial shareholders.
earnings_en: The latest financial results (30 June 2026) showed revenue of MYR 23.3 million, down 23.4% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 643,000, down 62.7% year-on-year, with a net margin of 2.8%.
